sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to all services provided by webvise (Sebastian Kehle), including design, development, automation, and consulting services. By engaging our services, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Services
sections.body: The scope, deliverables, timeline, and cost of each engagement are defined in a written proposal. Work begins only after mutual agreement on the proposal. Changes to scope are documented and may affect timeline and cost.

sections.heading: 3. Payment
items: Retainer engagements: Invoiced monthly at the beginning of each period.
Payment is due within 14 days of invoice date.
All prices are net and subject to applicable VAT.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: Upon full payment, all intellectual property rights to deliverables transfer to you. We retain the right to use the work in our portfolio unless otherwise agreed. Third-party licenses (fonts, libraries, services) remain subject to their respective terms.

sections.heading: 5. Warranties
sections.body: We deliver work to professional standards and provide post-launch bug fixes at no extra cost. We do not guarantee specific business outcomes (revenue, rankings, conversions) as these depend on factors beyond our control.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.body: Our liability is limited to the total fees paid for the engagement in question. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or lost profit damages. This does not affect liability for intent or gross negligence under German law.

sections.heading: 7. Confidentiality
sections.body: Both parties agree to keep confidential information private. This includes business strategies, technical details, and any non-public information shared during the engagement.

sections.heading: 8. AI Features & Third-Party Services
sections.body: Our website uses AI-powered features (such as the chat widget) that rely on third-party AI models. AI-generated responses are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute professional advice, binding offers, or guaranteed accuracy. We are not liable for decisions made based on AI-generated content. Our services may depend on third-party platforms (hosting, APIs, AI providers). We are not responsible for outages, changes, or limitations imposed by these providers.

sections.heading: 9. Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate with 14 days written notice. Work completed up to termination is invoiced proportionally. Retainers may be cancelled at the end of any billing period.

sections.heading: 10. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by German law. The place of jurisdiction is Potsdam, Germany.
